title: Lumped mass + central difference integrator
objective: Add explicit-dynamics integration: row-sum lumped mass matrix computation per element, central-difference time integrator, no linear solver needed. Add a new `DynamicsMode` switch to the generator.
scope: Add `mechdsl.solver.lumped_mass` that computes the row-sum lumped mass per element.
Add a new `dynamics_mode` enum: `STATIC` (default, Newton-Raphson) or `EXPLICIT` (central difference).
When explicit, the generator emits an `advance_one_step(dt)` function instead of `newton_solve(...)`.
The integrator updates a velocity field: v^{n+1/2} = v^{n-1/2} + dt * M_inv * (f_ext - f_int), u^{n+1} = u^n + dt * v^{n+1/2}.
Add a velocity Taichi field alongside u.
implementation_steps: Implement lumped mass for Hex8 (and stub for the other element types).
Unit-test: advance one step on a single free element, compare against a hand calculation.
acceptance_criteria: Lumped mass matches row-sum of the consistent mass within 1e-12.
Central-difference single-step matches hand calc on a free element.
Generator emits distinct source for EXPLICIT vs STATIC modes.
risks: Mass lumping can be inconsistent for higher-order elements (Hex20). Mitigation: scope to Hex8 first and add Hex20/Tet10 lumping as follow-ups.
completion_notes: DynamicsMode enum added to ProblemIR with auto-infer to STATIC (mirrors configuration pattern)
Hex8 row-sum lumped mass via 2x2x2 Gauss quadrature; Hex20/Tet4/Tet10 raise NotImplementedError
emit_explicit_driver emits advance_one_step(dt) and conditional v/M_lumped fields; STATIC path byte-identical
No Phase 5 integration-break: no strict-key-set guards tripped
